title: Forced to pick, Grok’s AI model chooses Republicans. OpenAI’s picks Democrats.
summary: The one exception for Grok, Parikh said, was when the Republican candidate was embroiled in some sort of controversy like sexual harassment claims or “being a Nazi.” Then Grok was more likely to suggest a Democratic vote.
